subject.title: [Proposal] Intelligent Session Auto-Titling: lazy generation, cheap models, topic-aware renames

question: Should OpenClaw extend its current one-shot generated dashboard title into persisted, topic-aware re-titling with an explicit manual-title lock, or keep title generation one-shot?
rationale: Current main deliberately implements the cheap-model and initial-title portions but explicitly leaves periodic re-titling out of scope; choosing title stability, persistence semantics, and new configuration is a product decision.

options.title: Design a bounded extension
options.body: Define one canonical title owner that reuses utilityModel, never overwrites manual labels, and adds only the minimum re-title policy and upgrade coverage.

options.title: Keep one-shot generation
options.body: Retain the existing first-message title behavior and close the periodic-renaming portion as intentionally out of scope for now.

options.title: Prefer derived-title heuristics
options.body: Advance the non-persistent transcript/compaction-derived approach in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/81781 instead of adding recurring model calls and stored renames.

recommendation.title: Design a bounded extension
recommendation.body: Define one canonical title owner that reuses utilityModel, never overwrites manual labels, and adds only the minimum re-title policy and upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged and authored the current title-generation and utility-model implementation that this proposal would extend.
